authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9980 *mahyā explicitly gives L. mañjh/majjh buffalo and a competing derivation through mahiṃśī. The survey many/mãny reflects the local palatal treatment, preserving uncertainty in the deeper reconstruction. Reviewed comparison: poth manj “buffalo” (f_dpshf2ktslhji). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
